top_signals.title: Scammer behind $245 million crypto heist pleads guilty to RICO charges
top_signals.summary: Malone Lam was indicted on scamming charges in September 2024 after drawing law enforcement scrutiny for parlaying stolen crypto into lavish Hamptons vacations, cars and private jets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
